part.name: Scissor lift linkage assembly
part.description: A 12-solid mechanical assembly comprising two parallel platform members, four crossed linkage plates arranged in two axial layers, four full-width corner pins, and two short central pivot pins. The linkage permits relative platform translation while maintaining approximately parallel platform orientation.
part.symmetry_note: The assembly has paired linkage layers near the two axial sides and two crossed diagonal link directions. The lower and upper platforms have corresponding elongated-slot and fixed-pivot interfaces, although their slot and fixed-pivot positions are not identical under simple translation. The mechanism is approximately symmetric about its central linkage plane and repeats across the axial thickness.

semantic_orientation.description: The platform centered near CAD y=1.752975 is interpreted as the lower platform, and the platform centered near CAD y=44.605773 as the upper platform. CAD X follows platform length, CAD Y follows lift height, and CAD Z follows assembly width/pin axes.
